step1_analysis.description: The circuit is a two-stage amplifier acting as a comparator. The first stage is a common-source amplifier with a PMOS active load, providing initial amplification and inversion. The second stage is a PMOS differential pair with an NMOS current mirror load, comparing the amplified signal against a reference voltage.

paper_reference.title: A 13.56MHz Wireless Power and Data Transfer Receiver Achieving 75.4% Effective-PowerConversion Efficiency with 0.1% ASK Modulation Depth and 9.2mW Output Power

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the comparator.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on typical SKY130 PMOS/NMOS parameters with 1.2V bias.

dc_gain.description: Maximum slope of the DC transfer characteristic.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain1 = gm3*(ro3||ro7) ~= 126 V/V. Gain2 = gm6*(ro2||ro6) ~= 75 V/V. Total Gain = 126 * 75 = 9450 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Product of the intrinsic gains of the two stages.

switching_threshold.description: Input voltage at LABEL_NET_0 that causes the output N2 to cross VDD/2.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the Vgs required for the input NMOS to sink the PMOS load current.

propagation_delay.description: Time delay between input crossing VDD/2 and output crossing VDD/2.

sky130_expected.calculation: Slew rate limited: dt = C * dV / I = 10fF * 0.9V / 8.1uA = 1.1ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on tail current charging a 10fF load capacitance.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power, DC gain, switching threshold, and propagation delay of the comparator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Comparator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBP2 LABEL_NET_2 0 1.2
VBP3 LABEL_NET_3 0 1.2
VREF LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VIN LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.5 pulse(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)

* Connect N4 to N1 to form current mirror load for the diff pair
V_N4 N4 N1 0

* DUT
XM1 N1 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 LABEL_NET_1 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 N0 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 LABEL_NET_3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

* Load Capacitor
CL N2 0 10f

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. DC Sweep
  dc VIN 0 1.8 0.001
  meas dc v_threshold find v(LABEL_NET_0) when v(N2)=0.9
  let gain = deriv(v(N2))
  meas dc max_gain max gain

  * 3. Transient Analysis
  tran 0.1n 40n
  meas tran t_delay_rise trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N2) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran t_delay_fall trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N2) val=0.9 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
